grammar.pattern: 不A不B：不慌不忙 / 不大不小
grammar.purpose: Recognize a fixed or licensed paired expression
grammar.explanation: 不慌不忙 means unhurried; 不大不小 describes an intermediate suitable size. These paired expressions differ in meaning and are not a productive instruction to combine any two verbs with 不. Learn the whole expression and its context. 不大不小 does not provide an exact measurement.

examples.zh: 她不慌不忙地核对地址。
examples.py: tā bù huāng bù máng de hé duì dì zhǐ .

examples.zh: 这个袋子不大不小，装这些书正合适。
examples.py: zhè gè dài zi bù dà bù xiǎo , zhuāng zhè xiē shū zhèng hé shì .
examples.en: This bag is neither large nor small; it suits these books.

examples.zh: 不慌不忙，不代表不认真。
examples.py: bù huāng bù máng , bù dài biǎo bù rèn zhēn .
examples.en: Being unhurried does not imply lack of care.

commonMistakes.why: The expression describes unhurried manner, not lack of care.

grammar.purpose: Concede a positive point before a limitation
grammar.explanation: 好是好，不过地点没确认 concedes goodness and then limits the endorsement. 是 repeats the acknowledged predicate; 就是/不过 introduces the reservation. The pattern is not an overall refusal by itself; the following clause supplies the actual problem.

examples.zh: 好是好，不过地点还没确认。
examples.py: hǎo shì hǎo , bù guò dì diǎn hái méi què rèn .
examples.en: It is good, but the location is still unconfirmed.

examples.zh: 简单是简单，就是少了时间。
examples.py: jiǎn dān shì jiǎn dān , jiù shì shǎo le shí jiān .
examples.en: It is simple, but it lacks the time.

examples.zh: 方便是方便，不过今天不合适。
examples.py: fāng biàn shì fāng biàn , bù guò jīn tiān bù hé shì .
examples.en: It is convenient, but unsuitable today.

commonMistakes.wrong: 好是好，所以完全没问题。
commonMistakes.right: 好是好，不过还有一个缺点。
commonMistakes.why: Here the concession prepares a reservation rather than a claim of perfection.

lines.zh: 周六去哪儿看电影？你选的那家店怎么样？
lines.py: zhōu liù qù nǎr kàn diàn yǐng ? nǐ xuǎn de nà jiā diàn zěn me yàng ?
lines.en: Where shall we watch the film on Saturday? How is the place you chose?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好是好，就是离车站有点远。
lines.py: hǎo shì hǎo , jiù shì lí chē zhàn yǒu diǎn yuǎn .
lines.en: It's good, but a little far from the station.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 多远？下车还要走很久？
lines.py: duō yuǎn ? xià chē hái yào zǒu hěn jiǔ ?
lines.en: How far? Is it a long walk after getting off?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 大概二十分钟。优点是旁边有小店，看完能吃饭。
lines.py: dà gài èr shí fēn zhōng . yōu diǎn shì páng biān yǒu xiǎo diàn , kàn wán néng chī fàn .
lines.en: About twenty minutes. The good part is the shops nearby; we can eat afterwards.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 要是下雨，二十分钟就不好玩了。
lines.py: yào shì xià yǔ , èr shí fēn zhōng jiù bù hǎo wán le .
lines.en: Twenty minutes won't be much fun in the rain.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那看看靠车站的那家？房间不大不小，三个人正好。
lines.py: nà kàn kàn kào chē zhàn de nà jiā ? fáng jiān bù dà bù xiǎo , sān gè rén zhèng hǎo .
lines.en: Shall we try the one near the station? The room is just right for three.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我看过照片，椅子好像不太舒服。
lines.py: wǒ kàn guò zhào piān , yǐ zi hǎo xiàng bù tài shū fú .
lines.en: I've seen the photos. The chairs don't look very comfortable.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 上次我坐过，还行。电影只有一个多小时。
lines.py: shàng cì wǒ zuò guò , hái xíng . diàn yǐng zhǐ yǒu yī gè duō xiǎo shí .
lines.en: I've sat there before. They're all right. The film is only a little over an hour.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那就选这家吧。我宁愿椅子简单一点，也不想淋雨。
lines.py: nà jiù xuǎn zhè jiā ba . wǒ nìng yuàn yǐ zi jiǎn dān yī diǎn , yě bù xiǎng lín yǔ .
lines.en: Let's choose it. I'd rather have simple chairs than get rained on.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行。我来订房间，你问小周几点能到。
lines.py: xíng . wǒ lái dìng fáng jiān , nǐ wèn xiǎo zhōu jǐ diǎn néng dào .
lines.en: Fine. I'll book the room; you ask when Xiao Zhou can get there.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好，选个地方也真考验耐心。
lines.py: hǎo , xuǎn gè dì fāng yě zhēn kǎo yàn nài xīn .
lines.en: Okay. Choosing a place really tests your patience.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 只要你别再拿出第四家，我们已经快选好了。
lines.py: zhǐ yào nǐ bié zài ná chū dì sì jiā , wǒ men yǐ jīng kuài xuǎn hǎo le .
lines.en: Just don't bring out a fourth place. We're nearly done.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我们想周六和小周一起看一部电影，找了三家有小房间的店。第一家照片很好看，但离车站要走二十分钟。
lines.py: wǒ men xiǎng zhōu liù hé xiǎo zhōu yì qǐ kàn yī bù diàn yǐng , zhǎo le sān jiā yǒu xiǎo fáng jiān de diàn . dì yī jiā zhào piān hěn hǎo kàn , dàn lí chē zhàn yào zǒu èr shí fēn zhōng .
lines.en: We wanted to watch a film with Xiao Zhou on Saturday and found three places with small rooms. The first looked lovely in photos but was a twenty-minute walk from the station.

lines.zh: 我本来最喜欢第一家，陈宇问我下雨时还想不想走。我看了一下天气，周六可能下雨，只好再看另外两家。
lines.py: wǒ běn lái zuì xǐ huān dì yī jiā , chén yǔ wèn wǒ xià yǔ shí hái xiǎng bù xiǎng zǒu . wǒ kàn le yī xià tiān qì , zhōu liù kě néng xià yǔ , zhǐ hǎo zài kàn lìng wài liǎng jiā .
lines.en: I liked the first best until Chen Yu asked about walking in the rain. The forecast suggested rain on Saturday, so I reconsidered the other two.

lines.zh: 第二家就在车站旁边，房间不大不小，三个人够坐。椅子看上去简单，陈宇说自己上次坐过，坐一个多小时没有问题。
lines.py: dì èr jiā jiù zài chē zhàn páng biān , fáng jiān bù dà bù xiǎo , sān gè rén gòu zuò . yǐ zi kàn shàng qù jiǎn dān , chén yǔ shuō zì jǐ shàng cì zuò guò , zuò yī gè duō xiǎo shí méi yǒu wèn tí .
lines.en: The second was right by the station, with a room sized for three. The chairs looked plain, but Chen Yu had sat there before and found them fine for a little over an hour.

lines.zh: 第三家椅子很舒服，可星期六只剩上午有空房间。小周上午要上班，所以这一家这次不合适。
lines.py: dì sān jiā yǐ zi hěn shū fú , kě xīng qī liù zhǐ shèng shàng wǔ yǒu kōng fáng jiān . xiǎo zhōu shàng wǔ yào shàng bān , suǒ yǐ zhè yī jiā zhè cì bù hé shì .
lines.en: The third had comfortable chairs, but only a morning slot remained on Saturday. Xiao Zhou worked in the morning, so it did not suit us this time.

lines.zh: 我们最后订了第二家下午三点的房间。我把地址发给小周，她说下车就能到，正好不用赶路。
lines.py: wǒ men zuì hòu dìng le dì èr jiā xià wǔ sān diǎn de fáng jiān . wǒ bǎ dì zhǐ fā gěi xiǎo zhōu , tā shuō xià chē jiù néng dào , zhèng hǎo bù yòng gǎn lù .
lines.en: We booked the second place for three in the afternoon. I sent Xiao Zhou the address. She was pleased it was right by the stop, so she would not have to rush.

lines.zh: 周六果然下雨了。我从车站走到店门口，只用了一分钟。陈宇问我还想不想去第一家，我说先让我把伞收好，再想那二十分钟的事。
lines.py: zhōu liù guǒ rán xià yǔ le . wǒ cóng chē zhàn zǒu dào diàn mén kǒu , zhǐ yòng le yī fēn zhōng . chén yǔ wèn wǒ hái xiǎng bù xiǎng qù dì yī jiā , wǒ shuō xiān ràng wǒ bǎ sǎn shōu hǎo , zài xiǎng nà èr shí fēn zhōng de shì .
lines.en: It did rain on Saturday. The walk from the station took one minute. Chen Yu asked if I still wanted the first place. I told him to let me fold my umbrella before considering that twenty-minute walk.

lines.py: zhè zhāng zhào piān bù shì wán měi de , dàn wǒ hěn xǐ huān .
lines.en: This photo isn't perfect, but I like it.

lines.zh: 他总想做得完美，反而迟迟不开始。
lines.py: tā zǒng xiǎng zuò de wán měi , fǎn ér chí chí bù kāi shǐ .
lines.en: He wants perfection so much that he never gets started.

lines.zh: 这间房的优点是离车站近。
lines.py: zhè jiān fáng de yōu diǎn shì lí chē zhàn jìn .
lines.en: This room's advantage is its proximity to the station.

lines.zh: 你说说这个办法的优点吧。
lines.py: nǐ shuō shuō zhè gè bàn fǎ de yōu diǎn ba .
lines.en: Tell me the advantages of this approach.

lines.zh: 她熟悉这里，这是她的优势。
lines.py: tā shú xī zhè lǐ , zhè shì tā de yōu shì .
lines.en: Knowing this place is her advantage.

lines.zh: 新车在速度上有优势。
lines.py: xīn chē zài sù dù shàng yǒu yōu shì .
lines.en: The new car has a speed advantage.

lines.zh: 早点准备对我们有利。
lines.py: zǎo diǎn zhǔn bèi duì wǒ men yǒu lì .
lines.en: Preparing early helps us.

lines.zh: 这个位置有利于大家看清屏幕。
lines.py: zhè gè wèi zhì yǒu lì yú dà jiā kàn qīng píng mù .
lines.en: This position helps everyone see the screen clearly.

lines.zh: 相比去年，今年的雨少了。
lines.py: xiāng bǐ qù nián , jīn nián de yǔ shǎo le .
lines.en: There is less rain this year than last year.

lines.zh: 相比坐车，我更想走过去。
lines.py: xiāng bǐ zuò chē , wǒ gèng xiǎng zǒu guò qù .
lines.en: I'd rather walk than take a bus.

lines.zh: 多花钱不必然带来更好的结果。
lines.py: duō huā qián bù bì rán dài lái gèng hǎo de jié guǒ .
lines.en: Spending more does not necessarily produce a better result.

lines.zh: 这两件事之间有必然的联系吗？
lines.py: zhè liǎng jiàn shì zhī jiān yǒu bì rán de lián xì ma ?
lines.en: Are these two things necessarily connected?

lines.zh: 不论下不下雨，我都去。
lines.py: bù lùn xià bù xià yǔ , wǒ dōu qù .
lines.en: I'll go whether it rains or not.

lines.zh: 不论谁来，都有地方坐。
lines.py: bù lùn shéi lái , dōu yǒu dì fāng zuò .
lines.en: There is a seat for whoever comes.

lines.zh: 这张表太复杂，我看不懂。
lines.py: zhè zhāng biǎo tài fù zá , wǒ kàn bù dǒng .
lines.en: This table is too complicated for me to understand.

lines.zh: 事情比我想的复杂。
lines.py: shì qíng bǐ wǒ xiǎng de fù zá .
lines.en: It's more complicated than I thought.

lines.zh: 我们先吃点简单的东西。
lines.py: wǒ men xiān chī diǎn jiǎn dān de dōng xi .
lines.en: Let's have something simple to eat first.

lines.zh: 这个问题其实很简单。
lines.py: zhè gè wèn tí qí shí hěn jiǎn dān .
lines.en: This problem is actually simple.

lines.zh: 这个消息可靠吗？
lines.py: zhè gè xiāo xī kě kào ma ?
lines.en: Is this news reliable?

lines.zh: 他是个可靠的朋友。
lines.py: tā shì gè kě kào de péng you .
lines.en: He is a dependable friend.

lines.zh: 这批产品检查以后都合格了。
lines.py: zhè pī chǎn pǐn jiǎn chá yǐ hòu dōu hé gé le .
lines.en: This batch of products passed inspection.

lines.zh: 他考试合格，可以参加下一次练习了。
lines.py: tā kǎo shì hé gé , kě yǐ cān jiā xià yī cì liàn xí le .
lines.en: He passed the test and can join the next exercise.

lines.zh: 她很坚强，没有放弃。
lines.py: tā hěn jiān qiáng , méi yǒu fàng qì .
lines.en: She is resilient and did not give up.

lines.zh: 经历这些以后，他变得更坚强了。
lines.py: jīng lì zhè xiē yǐ hòu , tā biàn de gèng jiān qiáng le .
lines.en: After these experiences he became stronger.

lines.zh: 老师批评我作业交得太晚。
lines.py: lǎo shī pī píng wǒ zuò yè jiāo de tài wǎn .
lines.en: The teacher criticised my late homework.

lines.zh: 他听了批评，重新改了一遍。
lines.py: tā tīng le pī píng , chóng xīn gǎi le yī biàn .
lines.en: He revised it again after hearing the criticism.

lines.zh: 这间房的缺点是晚上有点吵。
lines.py: zhè jiān fáng de quē diǎn shì wǎn shang yǒu diǎn chǎo .
lines.en: This room's drawback is that it is noisy at night.

lines.zh: 我也有缺点，常常忘带钥匙。
lines.py: wǒ yě yǒu quē diǎn , cháng cháng wàng dài yào shi .
lines.en: I have faults too; I often forget my keys.

lines.zh: 这台机器出了点毛病。
lines.py: zhè tái jī qì chū le diǎn máo bìng .
lines.en: There is something wrong with this machine.

lines.zh: 我的毛病是做事太急。
lines.py: wǒ de máo bìng shì zuò shì tài jí .
lines.en: My fault is rushing things.

lines.zh: 我不想一个人面对这件事。
lines.py: wǒ bù xiǎng yī gè rén miàn duì zhè jiàn shì .
lines.en: I don't want to face this alone.

lines.zh: 面对这么多人，他有点紧张。
lines.py: miàn duì zhè me duō rén , tā yǒu diǎn jǐn zhāng .
lines.en: Facing so many people made him nervous.

lines.zh: 我的脚有点痛。
lines.py: wǒ de jiǎo yǒu diǎn tòng .
lines.en: My foot hurts a little.

lines.zh: 这个消息让她心里很痛。
lines.py: zhè gè xiāo xī ràng tā xīn lǐ hěn tòng .
lines.en: This news hurt her deeply.

lines.zh: 那段等待让他很痛苦。
lines.py: nà duàn děng dài ràng tā hěn tòng kǔ .
lines.en: That wait was painful for him.

lines.zh: 她把痛苦的经历写进了日记。
lines.py: tā bǎ tòng kǔ de jīng lì xiě jìn le rì jì .
lines.en: She put the painful experience in her diary.

lines.zh: 这本书讲了几个人不同的命运。
lines.py: zhè běn shū jiǎng le jǐ gè rén bù tóng de mìng yùn .
lines.en: This book follows several people's different fates.

lines.zh: 那次见面改变了他的命运。
lines.py: nà cì jiàn miàn gǎi biàn le tā de mìng yùn .
lines.en: That meeting changed his fate.

lines.zh: 这把旧钥匙已经没用了。
lines.py: zhè bǎ jiù yào shi yǐ jīng méi yòng le .
lines.en: This old key no longer works.

lines.zh: 我试了几次，都没用。
lines.py: wǒ shì le jǐ cì , dōu méi yòng .
lines.en: I tried several times, but it didn't work.

lines.zh: 这次旅行很考验耐心。
lines.py: zhè cì lǚ xíng hěn kǎo yàn nài xīn .
lines.en: This trip tests our patience.

lines.zh: 朋友一起做事，也是一种考验。
lines.py: péng you yì qǐ zuò shì , yě shì yī zhǒng kǎo yàn .
lines.en: Working together can test a friendship.

lines.zh: 他坚持到底的精神让同学们很感动。
lines.py: tā jiān chí dào dǐ de jīng shén ràng tóng xué men hěn gǎn dòng .
lines.en: His determination to persevere moved his classmates.

lines.zh: 遇到困难也不放弃，这种精神值得学习。
lines.py: yù dào kùn nán yě bù fàng qì , zhè zhǒng jīng shén zhí de xué xí .
lines.en: Not giving up in difficulty is a spirit worth learning from.

glosses.meaning: for a long time without doing something

audio.zh: 大概二十分钟。优点是旁边有小店，看完能吃饭。
audio.py: dà gài èr shí fēn zhōng . yōu diǎn shì páng biān yǒu xiǎo diàn , kàn wán néng chī fàn .
audio.en: About twenty minutes. The good part is the shops nearby; we can eat afterwards.

tasks.statement: The walk is about twenty minutes.
tasks.why: This heard line explicitly supplies the information.

audio.zh: 周六果然下雨了。我从车站走到店门口，只用了一分钟。陈宇问我还想不想去第一家，我说先让我把伞收好，再想那二十分钟的事。
audio.py: zhōu liù guǒ rán xià yǔ le . wǒ cóng chē zhàn zǒu dào diàn mén kǒu , zhǐ yòng le yī fēn zhōng . chén yǔ wèn wǒ hái xiǎng bù xiǎng qù dì yī jiā , wǒ shuō xiān ràng wǒ bǎ sǎn shōu hǎo , zài xiǎng nà èr shí fēn zhōng de shì .
audio.en: It did rain on Saturday. The walk from the station took one minute. Chen Yu asked if I still wanted the first place. I told him to let me fold my umbrella before considering that twenty-minute walk.

tasks.statement: The walk from the station to the chosen place took twenty minutes.
tasks.why: The heard line explicitly gives a different result.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三34, 三68. Native check: concession X是X, fixed 不A不B combinations, 本事/毛病 colloquial register, 精神 noun jīngshén, balanced criticism and original scene rhythm. Medical vocabulary illustrates reports, without diagnosis or treatment claims. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 三27 / 三54 / 三31 / 三78: 衣服被雨弄湿了。, 把这本书交给她。, 哈哈，笑的是我自己。, 你今天也来参加活动？.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Earlier HSK 3 naturalness correction: a classmate helps with a small article, friends choose a rainy-day film venue, a photo makes a bridge look close, and two adults start swimming lessons. Removed identity/privacy/assessment cautions and report-like conversation. All target words have independently authored contexts instead of being stuffed into speech. Formed six text questions and nine or ten mixed tasks from the actual new facts while keeping all old IDs. Native flags: colloquial teasing about tickets and photos; 大主语/小主语 description; 好是好，就是; time-from 起 and elapsed 了; 精神 jīngshén as spirit versus the earlier energetic jīngshen; 录 as a bound verb in 录入; realistic descriptions of a first swimming class. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
